projection_scanner:
"""Name exact int card-ID literals in known APIs and unshadowed test objects."""
import collections,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/recovery')
from canonicalize_helpers import read,mask,sha

API={'get_internal_card_id_from_csv_id':0,'get_card_name_by_id':0,
     'my_base_value_by_id':0,'check_battlefield_for_id':1,'count_cards_by_id':1,
     'count_graveyard_by_id':1,'check_rfg':1}
HEX=r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+'
def definitions(code):
 pattern=r'(?m)^[ \t]*(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*[ \t\r\n*]+)+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\([^;{}]*\)\s*\{'
 found=[]
 for m in re.finditer(pattern,code):
  depth=1
  for at in range(m.end(),len(code)):
   depth+=(code[at]=='{')-(code[at]=='}')
   if depth==0:found.append((m[1],m.start(),at+1));break
  else:raise AssertionError('Unclosed function')
 return found

def named_uses(body,ids,filecode):
 code=mask(body);changes=[]
 def shadowed(name):
  if re.search(r'\b'+re.escape(name)+r'\s*=(?!=)|(?m:^\s*#\s*define\s+'+re.escape(name)+r'\b)',filecode):return True
  # Includes arbitrary typedef names, uninitialized/multiple declarators,
  # parameters, function pointers and enum members with implicit values.
  preceding=re.findall(r'\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)[ \t\r\n*]+'+re.escape(name)+r'\b',filecode)
  if any(word not in {'return','case','goto','sizeof','else'} for word in preceding):return True
  return bool(re.search(r'[,{}]\s*'+re.escape(name)+r'\b|\(\s*\*\s*'+re.escape(name)+r'\b',filecode))
 def put(a,b,kind,**context):
  token=code[a:b];number=int(token,16);names=ids.get(number,[])
  if len(names)!=1:return
  name=names[0]
  # Reject local enum/object or preprocessor shadows of a global ID name.
  if shadowed(name):return
  changes.append(dict(start=a,end=b,before=token,after=name,value=number,kind=kind,**context))
 for m in re.finditer(r'\b('+'|'.join(API)+r')\s*\(',code):
  if re.search(r'\(\s*\*\s*'+re.escape(m[1])+r'\b|(?m:^\s*#\s*define\s+'+re.escape(m[1])+r'\b)',filecode):continue
  starts=[m.end()];args=[];depth=0
  for at in range(m.end(),len(code)):
   ch=code[at]
   if ch in '([{':depth+=1
   elif ch in ')]}':
    if ch==')' and depth==0:
     args.append((starts[-1],at));break
    depth-=1
    assert depth>=0
   elif ch==',' and depth==0:
    args.append((starts[-1],at));starts.append(at+1)
  else:raise AssertionError('Unclosed call')
  arg=API[m[1]]
  if len(args)<=arg:continue
  a,b=args[arg];literal=re.fullmatch(r'\s*('+HEX+r')\s*',code[a:b])
  if literal:put(a+literal.start(1),a+literal.end(1),'public_csvid_argument',callee=m[1],argument=arg)
 depths=[];depth=0
 for ch in code:
  depths.append(depth);depth+=(ch=='{')-(ch=='}')
 for decl in re.finditer(r'\btest_definition_t\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*;',code):
  name=decl[1]
  if depths[decl.start()]!=1:continue
  declarations=list(re.finditer(r'(?m)^[ \t]*(?:(?:const|static|unsigned|signed|struct|union)\s+)*[A-Za-z_]\w*[\s*]+'+re.escape(name)+r'(?=[ \t]*[;=,\[])',code))
  if len(declarations)!=1 or not (declarations[0].start()<=decl.start()<declarations[0].end()):continue
  for m in re.finditer(r'\b'+re.escape(name)+r'\s*\.\s*id\s*=\s*('+HEX+r')\s*;',code):
   if m.start()<decl.end():continue
   put(m.start(1),m.end(1),'typed_test_csvid',object=name)
 offsets={(c['start'],c['end']) for c in changes};assert len(offsets)==len(changes)
 after=body
 for c in sorted(changes,key=lambda c:c['start'],reverse=True):after=after[:c['start']]+c['after']+after[c['end']:]
 # Literal substitution is exact, including value, type (plain signed int),
 # call syntax/order, all whitespace/comments and every untouched byte.
 reverse=after
 for c in sorted(changes,key=lambda c:c['start']):
  offset=c['start'];assert reverse[offset:offset+len(c['after'])]==c['after']
  reverse=reverse[:offset]+c['before']+reverse[offset+len(c['after']):]
 assert reverse==body
 return after,changes

def controls():
 ids={0x123:['CARD_ID_EXAMPLE']}
 shape=lambda b:b.replace('{','{\n').replace(';',';\n')
 positives=['int f(){return get_card_name_by_id(0x123);}',
 'int f(){return check_rfg(g(1,2),0x123);}',
 'int f(){test_definition_t test; test.id=0x123;}']
 for b in positives:
  b=shape(b);assert named_uses(b,ids,mask(b))[1],b
 negatives=['int f(){return add_card_to_rfg(0,0x123);}',
 'int f(){return check_rfg(0x123,1);}',
 'int f(){return check_rfg(0,0x123+0);}',
 'int f(){return check_rfg(0,(int)0x123);}',
 'int f(){return check_rfg(0,0x123U);}',
 'int f(){return check_rfg(0,0x124);}',
 'int f(){other_t test; test.id=0x123;}',
 'int f(){test_definition_t *test; test.id=0x123;}',
 'int f(){test_definition_t test; {int test;test.id=0x123;}}',
 'int f(){enum {CARD_ID_EXAMPLE=3}; return check_rfg(0,0x123);}',
 'int f(){return 0; /* check_rfg(0,0x123) */}',
 'int f(){puts("check_rfg(0,0x123)");}',
 'int f(){int CARD_ID_EXAMPLE;return check_rfg(0,0x123);}',
 'int f(int CARD_ID_EXAMPLE){return check_rfg(0,0x123);}',
 'int f(){int a,CARD_ID_EXAMPLE;return check_rfg(0,0x123);}',
 'int f(){enum {CARD_ID_EXAMPLE};return check_rfg(0,0x123);}',
 'int f(){int (*check_rfg)(int,int);return check_rfg(0,0x123);}',
 'int f(){test.id=0x123;test_definition_t test;}']
 for b in negatives:
  b=shape(b);assert not named_uses(b,ids,mask(b))[1],b
 b=positives[0];assert not named_uses(b,{0x123:['CARD_ID_EXAMPLE','CARD_ID_ALIAS']},mask(b))[1]
 return dict(positive=len(positives),negative=len(negatives)+1)

if __name__=='__main__':
 header=read('card_id.h');ids=collections.defaultdict(list)
 for n,v in re.findall(r'\b(CARD_ID_\w+)\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*,',header):ids[int(v)].append(n)
 assert ids and all(0<=n<0x7fffffff for n in ids)
 h=read('manalink.h')
 for name in API:assert re.search(r'(?m)^[^\n;{}]*\b'+name+r'\s*\([^;{}]*\)\s*;',h)
 assert not any(re.search(r'(?m)^\s*#\s*define\s+(?:'+'|'.join(API)+r')\b',read(p.as_posix())) for p in Path('.').glob('*.h'))
 tests=controls();ledger=json.loads(Path('docs/recovery-evidence/helper-canonicalization.json').read_bytes());rows=[]
 for f in ledger['files']:
  source=f['source']
  if not source.endswith('.c'):continue
  text=read(source);assert sha(text.encode())==f['canonical_sha256'];code=mask(text)
  defs=definitions(code);names=collections.Counter(d[0] for d in defs)
  for name,a,b in defs:
   if names[name]!=1:continue
   before=text[a:b];after,changes=named_uses(before,ids,code)
   if changes:rows.append(dict(source=source,name=name,before=before,after=after,before_sha256=sha(before.encode()),after_sha256=sha(after.encode()),substitutions=changes,kind='exact_named_card_id_literals'))
 out=dict(format=1,source_edits=rows,sites=sum(len(r['substitutions']) for r in rows),controls=tests,api_positions=API,header_sha256=sha(header.encode()),scanner_sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),scope='Known CSV-ID API slots and unshadowed function-top-level test_definition_t.id writes only; exact plain signed-int literal to unique header enum constant. No internal-IID API substitution, computed/casted/suffixed argument, ambiguous enum or behavior/native-body recovery claim.')
 Path('.recovery/reccmp/named-id-plan-c722.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(dict(definitions=len(rows),files=len({r['source'] for r in rows}),sites=out['sites'],controls=tests),indent=2))
